description: Manual review layer for the 5 benchmark/flagship hobbies (ZYNC_CARD_ART_PROMPT_SYSTEM_V1.md Benchmark Set: Badminton, Board Games, Bouldering, Cinema, Sushi). Unlike hobby_overrides_v1.json, these are populated proactively from actual pilot_v1 QA results, since flagship hobbies get manual review by design. 'override_prompt_additions' are appended to the compiled prompt; 'override_avoid' are appended to negative_constraints.

override_avoid: any readable real-world sportswear brand name or logo (e.g. do not render text on clothing or shoes)
badminton.reason: flux-2/edit comparison test (2026-09) hallucinated a real sportswear brand name on the shorts. Trademark/brand risk, not just a style issue.

boardgames.reason: Scored 5/5 across all four pilot QA categories. Treat as the reference execution for the group_play archetype; no correction required.

bouldering.reason: Scored 5/5 across all four pilot QA categories. Best-in-batch composition; no correction required.

override_prompt_additions: The screen must display a specific, legible illustrated movie moment (a scene with a subject and setting) — never an abstract color gradient or blank glow.
override_avoid: screen showing only abstract light/color with no depicted scene
cinema.reason: Pilot v1 attempt 1 scored 4/5 with an abstract color-gradient screen (a QA reroll trigger: 'weak or muddy composition'). Attempt 2 fixed this by requiring a legible scene on-screen and reached 5/5. Base recipe already carries this fix; override kept as an explicit, auditable guardrail for flagship review.

override_prompt_additions: Keep exactly one hand and one plate in frame; remove any secondary diner or background eating figure to keep focal hierarchy clean.
override_avoid: a second person eating in the background competing for focus
sushi.reason: Pilot v1 scored 4/5 on composition specifically because a background diner figure split attention from the hero plate.
